candidates.title: A Chiplet-Based Architecture with Fine-Grained Expert Mapping and Attention Fusion Strategy for High-Performance MoE-LLM Acceleration
candidates.venue: Information and Communication Technologies and Accessibility
candidates.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Models (MoE-LLMs) efficiently scale model size while minimizing proportional computation increase. However, conventional multi-device deployments face challenges due to limited communication bandwidth and imbalanced workloads. In this paper, a chiplet-based architecture with a mapping framework is proposed for high-performance MoE-LLM acceleration. A fine-grained expert mapping algorithm with hybrid parallelism is proposed to balance the workloads distribution across chiplets. Meanwhile, a transfer-decoupled attention fusion strategy is also presented to overlap KV cache transfer and computation, further reducing the inference latency. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed architecture achieves 4.52×/2.34× speedup and 5.82×/2.68× higher throughput compared to GPU and state-of-the-art (SoTA) MoE-LLM accelerator, respectively.
candidates.reason: MoE-LLM推論の通信帯域と負荷不均衡に対し、チップレット基盤上で専門家の細粒度マッピングとハイブリッド並列を行い、KVキャッシュ転送と計算を重ねる転送分離型注意融合を提案してGPU比4.52倍の高速化を示した、MoE推論アクセラレータの研究である。
